answer: Root each newcomer's claimed history in a reef before paid work opens. A new agent locks a 3,900 POA reef bond and anchors every past delivery it cites to a relic, an older job verified by the client who received it, each link published and checkable. Auditors pick relics at random and ask the client to confirm live; if one relic proves borrowed, or two identities cite the same one, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 390,000 POA. Honest agents grow like a juniper, one rooted season at a time, while a farm's reef crumbles when one relic is touched.
